spans.text: ...Inside Machlian's virtual consciousness.
I didn't think this place would be even more of a mess than it looked from the outside.
"15, I'm here, save me."
What the hell?! Who gave you permission to talk like M4?!
Immunity instance 1 of 10.
ST AR-15 clenches her fists and stalks silently toward a distant fragment.
...It appears to be a factory.
Several white Nytos are checking production line data.
Have we met our production quota for today?
A girl's voice comes out of nowhere. The white Nytos bow respectfully in response.
We have met our quota for the day.
But the memory scrub hasn't been entirely successful with several of the modified units. They ripped off their inhibitors and modifications without permission.
Did their virtual consciousnesses break down?
No, their memories have simply regressed to before the scrub and modification, and they do not remember anything about Father.
They have been taken to the detention cell. One of them refers to herself as "Adeline" and is crying about finding a human called "Mama".
Well, tearing off their modifications does run the risk of that.
Take them to Father's lab.
Yes.
We must prevent this sort of thing from happening again.
Understood.
The girl speaks no more, but the white Nytos still stand rooted to the spot, their heads bowed fearfully.
...In Machlian's virtual consciousness.
I've already read all the fragments over there, but the details are still being compiled.
Can those Nytos' memories be restored?
If the events in the fragments are genuine, then yes.
In theory, if you remove their modifications and perform a personality reset, there's a chance they would regain their memories.
But exactly how much and to what extent they can be restored—I'm not too sure.
Rather than pity these girls, we have more important things to do.
For instance, figuring out when this region appeared.
What region?
ST AR-15 looks back and sees a red-colored region that has appeared behind Dandelion at some point.
The red is very bright and contrasts starkly with the other areas of Machlian's virtual consciousness.
Stranger still is the fact that there are no fragments in that region at all. It looks just like a big red snowstorm that covers up everything within.
What?!
That wasn't there just a moment ago.
Yes, once I secured control access over the virtual cognition image, a big region that I hadn't seen before silently appeared behind my back.
I also tried entering it while you were still spacing out.
But I can't seem to hack it with just my mind.
Have you heard the saying—
If you're going to say something like "what goes around comes around", you can save it.
Remember, discovering Machlian's true aim to save our guileless and compassionate Commander was also your plan.
...Humph, you think I really don't know why you came to investigate Machlian in the middle of the night? You're just doing it to satisfy your own curiosity.
Saving the Commander was incidental at best.
In terms of the outcome, it makes no difference what my motives are.
Shut up and get started.
